note: Initial task-score policy from t-0083 research. Not calibrated: tune it only against real labelled cases. The three task scores are independent of the model roster; saved responses can be rerouted without inference.

difficulty.instructions: Assess the technical reasoning difficulty of completing the full task brief correctly, not its length or title. Consider coupled invariants, unfamiliar abstractions, and the reasoning needed to design and verify the change.
criteria: Mechanical, local change with an obvious solution
Novel architecture or subtle invariants requiring deep reasoning

ambiguity.instructions: Assess how much uncertainty the worker must resolve to complete this brief: unclear requirements, missing context, competing interpretations and open design decisions. Do not mistake a long precise brief for an ambiguous one.
criteria: Explicit requirements and clear acceptance tests
Minor gaps resolved by reading nearby code
Several plausible designs or substantial missing context
Conflicting requirements or fundamental open questions

blast_radius.instructions: Assess the consequences and scope of a wrong change in this brief. Consider persistent state, security, installation, shared infrastructure and cross-machine effects. Reading web documentation alone does not increase this score or make the product research.
criteria: Shared behavior, multiple consumers or build/install path
Durable state, security boundary or cross-system failure risk
